title: Korean Villagers of Jeju-Do File Back to Their Deserted homes
partOf: NARA › RG 111 › Photographs of American Military Activities
summary: Original Caption: Korean villages of the Island of Cheju-Do [Jeju-Do] file back to their deserted homes which they left recently due to the communist reign of terror which spreaded over the entire island in an attempt to disrupt the UN supervised elections.
